findings.quote: The aqueous and organic layers were partitioned and the organic layer was washed with brine (3 x 20 mL), dried (MgSO4)
findings.message: The source identifies the organic layer as the material carried forward through partitioning and all three washes. The four Separate steps should retain the organic phase, not an unknown phase. Its top or bottom position need not be inferred.

findings.quote: dried (MgSO4), filtered and the solvent removed under vacuum to leave a crude oil
findings.message: The filtration is followed by solvent removal from the liquid product stream. Encode retention of the filtrate rather than leaving the retained stream unspecified.
